note: Triennial election of the county council, 1967: polled 1 June 1967 in two divisions (Newtownhamilton and Bessbrook). The other divisions were returned unopposed, but no list of those members was found except Killyman. The first contest in the division for 40 years; the seat was vacated by William (J.) Cooke, retired (Newry Reporter, 1 June 1967, p. 8, and 8 June 1967, p. 2). An 88 per cent poll. The Belfast Telegraph (2 June 1967, p. 8) prints the same figures: Donaldson (U.) 777, O'Neill (Independent) 690.
